sources.title: GitHub - xulihang/PP_DocLayout_ONNX: PaddlePaddle's DocLayout using ONNX
sources.snippet: PP_DocLayout_ONNX PaddlePaddle's DocLayout using ONNX. PPDocLayout v3 and PPDocLayout L are supported. How to use in ImageTrans: PPDocLayout V3 Create a folder named ppdoclayout under the models folder in ImageTrans's root. Create a new model.json file under the ppdoclayout folder.
